x-tool-namespaces.source: the plugin's bash layer via host subprocess
x-tool-namespaces.shellPermission: Mode row enabled with the matching preset AND publishBashTool AND authoritative per-session DSH policy; restricted modes require host confinement

x-components.presentation: One row configures every feature: the four preset modes, discovery, capture and the TUI link each carry their own switch and settings on the row page.
x-components.notes: A feature that is switched off in the row page is not mounted at all, exactly like the old per-row switch. Legacy component specifiers (mode-*, discovery, panel, tui, shell, file, ptc, hide-official, background) remain exported so a saved override still loads its module, but they are no longer inserted by the bundle.
